name: Regex interpolation with canonical flags and named captures

input.source_text: module M { public fun run() -> Array { let term = "a+b"; let r = /^${term}(?<digits>[0-9]+)$/mi; let found = "A+B42" =~ r; [found.text(), found.capture(:digits)] } } M.run()

applicability.reason: Pure Iris source has no native boundary.
